title: Rename fetchUsr to fetchUser across the module

brief.goal: Rename the exported function `fetchUsr` in src/api.ts to `fetchUser` and update every caller so the existing test keeps passing. No other behaviour changes.
constraints: Change only the files named in the goal; no new dependencies
Keep TypeScript strict; relative imports use explicit .ts extensions
Tests use node:test and node:assert/strict and run with node --experimental-strip-types --test
acceptanceCriteria: src/api.ts exports `fetchUser` and no longer mentions `fetchUsr`
src/index.ts imports and uses `fetchUser`; no file still references `fetchUsr`
getUserName keeps returning the same values

expected_clean_output: Both files renamed; no fetchUsr left; existing test and grader pass.

seeded_defect.description: Only src/api.ts was renamed; src/index.ts still imports fetchUsr, so the module fails to load.
seeded_defect.how_to_detect: grep fetchUsr finds src/index.ts; test/index.test.ts fails with a missing export.
